art_room:1.object_zh: 围裙工具柜 · 画笔与小围裙
art_room:1.phrase_en: Put on a clean art apron and pick a soft paintbrush before painting!
art_room:1.phrase_zh: 打开美术室围裙柜系好防脏小围裙，挑一支顺手的软毛画笔吧！
art_room:1.activity_zh: 认识创作时使用的围裙和工具

art_room:2.object_zh: 颜料调色台 · 红黄蓝调色盘
art_room:2.phrase_en: Mix yellow and blue paint on the palette — look, it turns bright green!
art_room:2.phrase_zh: 在颜料调色台上把黄颜料和蓝颜料混在一起——哇，变成鲜绿色啦！
art_room:2.activity_zh: 观察颜料颜色与调色盘

art_room:3.phrase_en: Stand in front of the wooden easel and paint a sunny island picture!
art_room:3.phrase_zh: 站在木画架前拿起画笔，在画布上描绘阳光明媚的小岛风景吧！
art_room:3.activity_zh: 在画架前观察示例画作

art_room:4.object_zh: 陶泥手工桌 · 捏小动物
art_room:4.phrase_en: Shape soft brown clay on the table into a cute little rabbit or cup!
art_room:4.phrase_zh: 在陶泥桌上揉一揉柔软的陶土，捏出一只长耳小兔或小茶杯吧！

art_room:5.object_zh: 美术作品墙 · 缤纷画展
art_room:5.phrase_en: Walk along the gallery wall and tell which colourful painting you like best!
art_room:5.phrase_zh: 沿着美术室作品墙欣赏大家的画作，说说你最喜欢哪一幅色彩！

canteen:1.object_zh: 入口菜单板 · 今日美味食谱
canteen:1.phrase_en: Read the canteen menu board: warm milk, fresh bread, fish, and apples!
canteen:1.phrase_zh: 看看食堂入口菜单板上的今日美食：温牛奶、软面包、鱼肉和红苹果！

canteen:2.object_zh: 洁净餐具台 · 勺子筷子与餐盘
canteen:2.phrase_en: Take a clean tray, a spoon, and chopsticks from the cutlery stand.
canteen:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧餐具台取一只干净餐盘、一把小勺和一双筷子。

canteen:3.object_zh: 中央取餐窗口 · 礼貌点餐
canteen:3.phrase_en: Smile at the chef by the window: I'd like some bread and warm soup, please!
canteen:3.phrase_zh: 在中央取餐窗口礼貌地对主厨说：请给我一些面包和热汤，谢谢！

canteen:4.object_zh: 阳光用餐桌 · 与同学共进午餐
canteen:4.phrase_en: Sit with your classmates at the sunny table and enjoy a yummy lunch!
canteen:4.phrase_zh: 端着餐盘在右侧用餐分享桌坐下，和同学们开心地享用营养午餐！
canteen:4.activity_zh: 与同学描述口味并道谢

canteen:5.object_zh: 餐盘回收台 · 光盘归位
canteen:5.phrase_en: Carry your empty tray and bowl neatly to the return stand after lunch.
canteen:5.phrase_zh: 吃完午餐做到光盘不浪费，再把空餐盘和小碗整齐送回出口回收台。

classroom:1.object_zh: 门口姓名牌台 · 桌签卡
classroom:1.phrase_en: Find your name card on the stand and say: Hello, nice to meet you!
classroom:1.phrase_zh: 在门口姓名牌台找到名字卡，微笑着打招呼：你好，很高兴认识你！

classroom:2.object_zh: 左窗阅读角 · 英语绘本架
classroom:2.phrase_en: Open a picture book in the sunny reading corner and read aloud!
classroom:2.phrase_zh: 在明亮的左窗阅读角翻开一本图画书，跟着示范大声读一句吧！

classroom:3.object_zh: 中央结伴课桌 · 黑板与讲台
classroom:3.phrase_en: Sit at the partner desk, look at the blackboard, and greet your classmate!
classroom:3.phrase_zh: 在中央结伴课桌坐好，看向黑板，和同桌用英语互相问好吧！
classroom:3.activity_zh: 与伙伴问候和介绍名字

classroom:4.object_zh: 情境道具柜 · 课堂头饰与词卡
classroom:4.phrase_en: Pick word cards and puppets from the cabinet for our classroom game!
classroom:4.phrase_zh: 从右侧情境道具柜取出手偶和单词卡，一起演一段有趣的课堂对话！
classroom:4.activity_zh: 取当前情境需要的道具

classroom:5.object_zh: 班级作品墙 · 优秀画作贴纸
classroom:5.phrase_en: Look at our colourful drawings and star stickers on the classroom wall!
classroom:5.phrase_zh: 欣赏出口作品墙上同学们贴满星星贴纸的英语小报与画作吧！
classroom:5.activity_zh: 展示完成的图片或记录

football_field:1.object_zh: 球场装备区 · 足球与队服背心
football_field:1.phrase_en: Put on your team jersey and lace up your shoes by the football bench!
football_field:1.phrase_zh: 在装备区穿好鲜艳的运动队服背心，系紧球鞋鞋带准备上场！
football_field:1.activity_zh: 观察足球、训练背心和装备收纳位置

football_field:2.object_zh: 绿茵开球中圈 · 准备开球
football_field:2.phrase_en: Place the black-and-white football on the white centre spot to kick off!
football_field:2.phrase_zh: 把黑白相间的足球稳稳放在绿茵场开球中圈的白点上准备开球！
football_field:2.activity_zh: 走到中圈认识开球位置与球场边线

football_field:3.object_zh: 白色射门球门 · 瞄准球网射门
football_field:3.phrase_en: Aim carefully at the wide white goalpost and kick the ball into the net!
football_field:3.phrase_zh: 站在球门前看准空当，飞起一脚把足球稳稳踢进球网得分！
football_field:3.activity_zh: 在球门前观察球门结构与射门方向

football_field:4.object_zh: 锥桶传球区 · 带球绕桩配合
football_field:4.phrase_en: Dribble around the orange cones and pass the football to your teammate!
football_field:4.phrase_zh: 灵巧地带球绕过橙色训练锥桶，再把足球稳稳传给队友！
football_field:4.activity_zh: 看看锥桶标记和传球路线示意

football_field:5.object_zh: 看台计分牌 · 为双方喝彩
football_field:5.phrase_en: Check the match scoreboard by the stand and cheer for every great play!
football_field:5.phrase_zh: 抬头看看看台计分牌上的比分，为球场上每一次精彩配合鼓掌喝彩！
football_field:5.activity_zh: 在看台前观察计分牌与比赛信息示例

home:1.phrase_en: Put your bag and cap in the hall basket, please.
home:1.phrase_zh: 进门后，请把你的书包和帽子放进门厅随身篮里吧。
home:1.activity_zh: 欢迎朋友进来，把带来的物品放在门厅。

home:2.phrase_en: Open the wooden wardrobe and hang up your warm coat.
home:2.phrase_zh: 打开左侧木衣柜，把暖和的外套整齐挂好。
home:2.activity_zh: 在进门处挂好外套，也可以继续布置客厅。

home:3.phrase_en: Set two clean cups of warm tea on the living room table.
home:3.phrase_zh: 在客厅中央茶几上摆好两只干净的暖茶杯吧。
home:3.activity_zh: 摆好茶杯与点心，和朋友介绍自己的家。

home:4.phrase_en: Open the photo album by the window to see my happy family.
home:4.phrase_zh: 翻开窗边的家庭相册，看看我们幸福的一家人。
home:4.activity_zh: 看看相册，用照片介绍家人；晚上去卧室休息。

home:5.phrase_en: Place our holiday gifts and cards neatly on the memory shelf.
home:5.phrase_zh: 把节日礼物与纪念贺卡整齐摆回出口展示架上。
home:5.activity_zh: 把合照与礼物放回纪念架，回想家人和朋友相聚的日子。

home_balcony:1.phrase_en: Hang the clean socks on the sunny rack above the laundry basket.
home_balcony:1.phrase_zh: 把洗衣篮里洗干净的小袜子夹在阳光晾衣架上晒干吧。
home_balcony:1.activity_zh: 将洗好的袜子挂好，再整理衣篮。

home_balcony:2.phrase_en: Give fresh water to the green plants on the sunny stand.
home_balcony:2.phrase_zh: 给阳台盆栽照料台上的绿叶小植物浇一点清凉的水吧。
home_balcony:2.activity_zh: 观察盆栽，学着给植物浇水。

home_balcony:3.phrase_en: Wipe the balcony window with a soft cloth until the glass shines!
home_balcony:3.phrase_zh: 用干净的软布擦一擦阳台大窗户，让玻璃亮晶晶！
home_balcony:3.activity_zh: 擦一擦窗户，看看家人在做什么。

home_balcony:4.phrase_en: Hold the broom and sweep the balcony floor nice and tidy.
home_balcony:4.phrase_zh: 拿起角落的小扫帚和簸箕，把阳台地面扫得整整齐齐。
home_balcony:4.activity_zh: 找到扫帚，把地面的小纸屑扫起来。

home_balcony:5.phrase_en: Close the tap and store the clean bucket neatly in the corner.
home_balcony:5.phrase_zh: 关好阳台水龙头，把干净的小水桶收进节水储物角里。
home_balcony:5.activity_zh: 洗衣后关好水，收起用品。

home_bathroom:1.phrase_en: Take your toothbrush from the cup and brush your teeth clean!
home_bathroom:1.phrase_zh: 拿起牙刷杯里的小牙刷，对着镜子把牙齿刷得白白净净！
home_bathroom:1.activity_zh: 认识牙刷与牙齿，跟着句子做刷牙动作。

home_bathroom:2.phrase_en: Wash your hands with bubbles in the clean washbasin.
home_bathroom:2.phrase_zh: 在清爽的洗手池前搓出泡泡，把小手洗得干干净净。
home_bathroom:2.activity_zh: 打开水龙头洗手，用完记得关好。

home_bathroom:3.phrase_en: A warm shower in the bathroom keeps our body fresh and clean.
home_bathroom:3.phrase_zh: 在浴缸与花洒旁冲个温水澡，让身体每天都清爽干净。
home_bathroom:3.activity_zh: 认识浴室，想想每天怎样保持身体清洁。

home_bathroom:4.phrase_en: Wipe your face dry and hang the soft towel back on the rack.
home_bathroom:4.phrase_zh: 洗完脸擦干水珠，再把柔软的毛巾挂回收纳架原位。
home_bathroom:4.activity_zh: 洗过脸后，把毛巾挂回原位。

home_bathroom:5.phrase_en: Turn off the water tap tightly after washing — let's save water!
home_bathroom:5.phrase_zh: 洗完手记得把水龙头拧紧关好——一起养成节约用水的好习惯！
home_bathroom:5.activity_zh: 检查水龙头已经关闭，养成节约用水的习惯。

home_bedroom:1.phrase_en: Fold the soft quilt neatly and make your bed every morning.
home_bedroom:1.phrase_zh: 每天早上把松软的被子叠整齐，铺好自己的小床。
home_bedroom:1.activity_zh: 把被子铺好，再摆正枕头。

home_bedroom:2.phrase_en: Look at the little clock by the bed! I get up at seven o'clock.
home_bedroom:2.phrase_zh: 看看床头滴答响的小闹钟！我早上七点钟起床。
home_bedroom:2.activity_zh: 看一看起床时间，讲讲自己的早晨。

home_bedroom:3.phrase_en: Stand before the mirror and choose a clean shirt or dress today.
home_bedroom:3.phrase_zh: 站在穿衣镜前照一照，挑一件今天想穿的漂亮衣服吧。
home_bedroom:3.activity_zh: 选择今天喜欢的衣服，看看颜色。

home_bedroom:4.phrase_en: Pack your pencil box and ruler into your schoolbag.
home_bedroom:4.phrase_zh: 把文具盒和尺子收好，装进收纳凳上的书包里。
home_bedroom:4.activity_zh: 找找铅笔盒，把物品放回书包里。

home_bedroom:5.phrase_en: Turn off the warm bedside lamp when it is time to go to bed.
home_bedroom:5.phrase_zh: 读完睡前故事，准备睡觉时记得关掉温暖的床头阅读灯哦。
home_bedroom:5.activity_zh: 读一会儿书，再去休息；可以睡到游戏中的第二天。

home_dining:1.phrase_en: Pour a glass of warm milk from the breakfast sideboard.
home_dining:1.phrase_zh: 从早餐边柜端起一杯温牛奶，开启元气满满的早晨。
home_dining:1.activity_zh: 看时钟准备早餐，讲讲自己的早餐时间。

home_dining:2.phrase_en: Pick a sweet red apple or a yellow banana from the fruit tray!
home_dining:2.phrase_zh: 从阳光水果分享盘里挑一颗红苹果或黄香蕉吧！
home_dining:2.activity_zh: 看看水果，说说自己喜欢哪一种。

home_dining:3.phrase_en: Set the plates and chopsticks on the table — dinner is ready!
home_dining:3.phrase_zh: 在家庭餐桌上摆好餐盘和筷子——香喷喷的晚餐准备好啦！
home_dining:3.activity_zh: 为家人摆好餐盘，再一起吃饭。

home_dining:4.phrase_en: Light the candles on the birthday cake and make a sweet wish!
home_dining:4.phrase_zh: 点亮生日点心桌上蛋糕的小蜡烛，许一个温暖的心愿吧！
home_dining:4.activity_zh: 摆放生日蛋糕和贺卡，向家人送上祝福。

home_dining:5.phrase_en: Take out the big round plates for our warm family dinner.
home_dining:5.phrase_zh: 从节日餐边架取出大圆盘，准备一家人团聚的丰盛晚餐。
home_dining:5.activity_zh: 观察节日餐具，聊聊一家人团聚的晚餐。

home_estate:1.room_name: 我的家 · 小院与住宅
home_estate:1.phrase_en: Open the mailbox and read the welcome card: Welcome to my home!
home_estate:1.phrase_zh: 打开门前信箱读读迎宾卡：欢迎来到我家！
home_estate:1.activity_zh: 读一张邀请卡，想想怎样欢迎来访的朋友。

home_estate:2.room_name: 我的家 · 小院与住宅
home_estate:2.phrase_en: Lift the watering can and water the colourful flowers.
home_estate:2.phrase_zh: 提起浇水壶，给小院五彩的花朵浇浇水吧。
home_estate:2.activity_zh: 拿起水壶，为花圃浇水，再把水壶放回去。

home_estate:3.room_name: 我的家 · 小院与住宅
home_estate:3.phrase_en: Put your sun hat and water bottle in the porch basket.
home_estate:3.phrase_zh: 出门散步前，把遮阳帽和水壶放进门廊随身篮吧。
home_estate:3.activity_zh: 外出前整理随身物品，准备与家人一起散步。

home_estate:4.room_name: 我的家 · 小院与住宅
home_estate:4.phrase_en: Check our family board! Breakfast is at seven thirty.
home_estate:4.phrase_zh: 看一看家庭日程板！我们的早餐在七点半开始。
home_estate:4.activity_zh: 看看日程板，选择今天先去哪个房间。

home_estate:5.room_name: 我的家 · 小院与住宅
home_estate:5.phrase_en: Water the young tree every day so it grows tall and green.
home_estate:5.phrase_zh: 每天给门廊边的小树苗浇水，让它长得又高又绿。
home_estate:5.activity_zh: 观察小树怎样给门廊遮阴，照顾它慢慢长大。

home_kitchen:1.phrase_en: Open the kitchen cupboard to find rice, noodles, and fresh food.
home_kitchen:1.phrase_zh: 打开厨房食材储物柜，找找米饭、面条和新鲜食材。
home_kitchen:1.activity_zh: 认识米饭、鱼和蔬菜，挑选今天的食材。

home_kitchen:2.phrase_en: Wash the green vegetables in the clean kitchen sink.
home_kitchen:2.phrase_zh: 把翠绿的蔬菜放进干净的洗菜池里冲一冲、洗干净。
home_kitchen:2.activity_zh: 将蔬菜放入水槽，洗净后放回篮子。

home_kitchen:3.phrase_en: Warm soup is bubbling in the pot on the stove!
home_kitchen:3.phrase_zh: 灶台上的汤锅正咕嘟咕嘟冒着香喷喷的热气呢！
home_kitchen:3.activity_zh: 看一看做饭的工具，和家人一起准备一餐。

home_kitchen:4.phrase_en: Arrange the washed tomatoes and eggs on the kitchen counter.
home_kitchen:4.phrase_zh: 把洗净的西红柿和鸡蛋整齐摆在明亮的备餐操作台上。
home_kitchen:4.activity_zh: 介绍厨房，观察台面上准备好的物品。

home_kitchen:5.phrase_en: Put the clean bowls and spoons back on the dish rack.
home_kitchen:5.phrase_zh: 把洗干净的小碗和勺子放回餐具收纳架上沥干。
home_kitchen:5.activity_zh: 用过的餐具归位，保持厨房干净。

home_study:1.phrase_en: Use the computer on the study desk to send a friendly email.
home_study:1.phrase_zh: 在窗边电脑书桌上给好朋友发一封温暖的问候邮件吧。
home_study:1.activity_zh: 看看电脑能帮我们做什么；这里的问候只发生在游戏里。

home_study:2.phrase_en: Pick an interesting storybook from the wooden bookshelf.
home_study:2.phrase_zh: 从整洁的绘本书架上挑一本你最感兴趣的故事书吧。
home_study:2.activity_zh: 把读完的书放回书架，再挑一个故事。

home_study:3.phrase_en: Sit by the sunny window and read a wonderful book quietly.
home_study:3.phrase_zh: 坐在阳光洒满的靠窗阅读座上，安安静静读一会儿好书。
home_study:3.activity_zh: 晚上坐下来读一会儿书。

home_study:4.phrase_en: Put your pencils, eraser, and ruler neatly into the pencil case.
home_study:4.phrase_zh: 把铅笔、橡皮和尺子整整齐齐收进文具整理桌的铅笔盒里。
home_study:4.activity_zh: 找一找铅笔盒，把文具放到合适的位置。

home_study:5.phrase_en: Draw a bright rainbow with crayons to make a thank-you card!
home_study:5.phrase_zh: 拿起手工台上的彩笔画一道彩虹，做一张漂亮的感谢贺卡吧！
home_study:5.activity_zh: 画一张送给家人的卡片，表达自己的心意。

landmark_A:1.object_zh: 采果藤篮 · 果园入口
landmark_A:1.phrase_en: Pick up a woven basket at the gate before picking apples.
landmark_A:1.phrase_zh: 在果园门口领一只轻巧藤篮，准备去树下采苹果吧。

landmark_A:2.phrase_en: Look up at the green apple tree — sweet red apples hang on the branches!
landmark_A:2.phrase_zh: 抬头看看繁茂的苹果树——红彤彤的甜苹果正挂满枝头呢！

landmark_A:3.phrase_en: Count the apples on the wooden table: one, two, three, four, five!
landmark_A:3.phrase_zh: 在中央分拣台上数一数红苹果：一、二、三、四、五！

landmark_A:4.phrase_en: Wash the fresh apples in cool clear water before tasting them.
landmark_A:4.phrase_zh: 把刚摘下的红苹果放进清凉的洗果池里洗得亮晶晶。

landmark_A:5.phrase_en: Share a basket of crisp sweet apples with our island neighbours!
landmark_A:5.phrase_zh: 从出口礼物架端起一篮脆甜苹果，送给小岛邻居分享吧！

landmark_B:1.phrase_en: Read the wooden dock sign to check where our boat will sail.
landmark_B:1.phrase_zh: 看看岸边木路牌上的箭头，确认小船今天要驶向哪座海湾。

landmark_B:2.phrase_en: Sit on the harbour bench and watch little boats rock on the waves.
landmark_B:2.phrase_zh: 坐在码头边的木长凳上，看小木船在波浪上轻轻摇晃。

landmark_B:3.phrase_en: Tie the boat rope safely around the sturdy wooden post.
landmark_B:3.phrase_zh: 把小木船的缆绳稳稳系在中央结实的系船木柱上。

landmark_B:4.object_zh: 码头货架 · 物资木箱
landmark_B:4.phrase_en: Stack the wooden boxes neatly on the harbour shelf.
landmark_B:4.phrase_zh: 把出航物资木箱按大小整整齐齐码放在右侧货架上。

landmark_B:5.phrase_en: Check the life ring by the cabin door before we set sail!
landmark_B:5.phrase_zh: 推开船舱门出发前，先检查门边的橙色救生圈是否挂好！

landmark_C:1.object_zh: 烘焙订单板 · 甜点单
landmark_C:1.phrase_en: Read today's bakery order board — someone wants an apple cake!
landmark_C:1.phrase_zh: 看看门口的烘焙订单板——有位客人点了一份香甜苹果蛋糕！

landmark_C:2.object_zh: 原料木架 · 鸡蛋牛奶
landmark_C:2.phrase_en: Take fresh eggs, milk, and flour from the ingredient shelf.
landmark_C:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧材料架取出新鲜鸡蛋、牛奶和面粉。

landmark_C:3.object_zh: 料理台 · 奶油搅拌碗
landmark_C:3.phrase_en: Mix the batter and pipe sweet white cream onto the cake!
landmark_C:3.phrase_zh: 在中央料理台搅匀面糊，再给蛋糕挤上一圈香甜白奶油！

landmark_C:4.phrase_en: Mmm, smell the warm cake baking inside the golden oven!
landmark_C:4.phrase_zh: 闻一闻！右侧烤箱里正飘出烤蛋糕暖融融的甜香呢！

landmark_C:5.object_zh: 取餐木窗 · 蛋糕礼盒
landmark_C:5.phrase_en: Hand the warm cake box through the window with a big smile!
landmark_C:5.phrase_zh: 在出口取餐窗微笑着递出系好丝带的蛋糕盒吧！

landmark_D:1.object_zh: 节目木牌 · 合奏曲目
landmark_D:1.phrase_en: Check the concert board to choose our happy rhythm song!
landmark_D:1.phrase_zh: 看看音乐厅门口的节目牌，挑一首今天要合奏的欢快曲目吧！

landmark_D:2.phrase_en: Pick up a pair of smooth wooden drumsticks from the rack.
landmark_D:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧乐器架上拿起一对光滑轻巧的小木鼓槌。

landmark_D:3.phrase_en: Tap the big round drum: boom, boom, clap to the beat!
landmark_D:3.phrase_zh: 敲响舞台中央的大圆鼓：咚、咚、哒，跟着节拍一起合奏！

landmark_D:4.object_zh: 排练木席 · 轮流合奏
landmark_D:4.phrase_en: Sit on the rehearsal bench and listen — now it is your turn!
landmark_D:4.phrase_zh: 坐在右侧排练席上认真倾听伙伴的鼓声——现在轮到你演奏啦！

landmark_D:5.phrase_en: Pin our joyful band photo onto the concert memory wall!
landmark_D:5.phrase_zh: 把我们神采飞扬的合奏照片贴在出口纪念墙上吧！

landmark_E:1.object_zh: 照料记录板 · 孵蛋表
landmark_E:1.phrase_en: Check the care chart to keep every little egg warm and safe.
landmark_E:1.phrase_zh: 查看门口的照料记录板，了解守护每一枚小蛋壳的温暖步骤。

landmark_E:2.phrase_en: Fluff up the soft warm cushion so the eggs never roll away.
landmark_E:2.phrase_zh: 把左侧的绒毛软垫铺得松软暖和，不让小蛋壳滚落。

landmark_E:3.object_zh: 暖光孵化台 · 小雏鸡
landmark_E:3.phrase_en: Listen closely! A yellow chick is tapping inside the white egg!
landmark_E:3.phrase_zh: 凑近中央孵化台仔细听！一只黄绒毛小鸡正在白蛋壳里轻轻啄壳呢！

landmark_E:4.object_zh: 食水小架 · 清水谷粒
landmark_E:4.phrase_en: Fill the tiny bowl with clean water and grain for the hungry chick.
landmark_E:4.phrase_zh: 给右侧食水架添满干净的清水与小米粒，招待刚破壳的小鸡。

landmark_E:5.object_zh: 观察木窗 · 成长画页
landmark_E:5.phrase_en: Draw how the little egg hatched into a fluffy chick in our diary!
landmark_E:5.phrase_zh: 站在出口观察窗前，把蛋壳孵出毛茸茸小鸡的变化画进日记本吧！

landmark_F:1.phrase_en: Choose a packet of flower seeds from the wooden seed box.
landmark_F:1.phrase_zh: 从温室门口的木盒里挑一袋饱满的花朵种子吧。

landmark_F:2.object_zh: 花盆工作台 · 松软泥土
landmark_F:2.phrase_en: Plant the tiny seed gently in a terracotta flowerpot with soft soil.
landmark_F:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧花盆台捧起松软泥土，把小花种轻轻种进红陶花盆里。

landmark_F:3.object_zh: 五彩花床 · 鲜艳花瓣
landmark_F:3.phrase_en: Look at the central flower bed — red, yellow, and pink flowers bloom!
landmark_F:3.phrase_zh: 看中央花床里百花盛开——红的、黄的、粉的花瓣真灿烂呀！

landmark_F:4.phrase_en: Fill your watering can at the basin and give thirsty flowers a drink.
landmark_F:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧水池灌满小喷壶，给口渴的花朵们洒下清甜水珠。

landmark_F:5.object_zh: 花束展示架 · 丝带花束
landmark_F:5.phrase_en: Tie a bright ribbon around the fresh flower bouquet for a friend!
landmark_F:5.phrase_zh: 在出口花束架系上漂亮丝带，把芬芳的小花束送给好朋友！

landmark_G:1.object_zh: 旅行卡架 · 探索通行证
landmark_G:1.phrase_en: Take a travel pass at the stand and start your world journey!
landmark_G:1.phrase_zh: 在入口旅行卡架领一张探索卡，开启奇妙的环球小旅程！

landmark_G:2.object_zh: 明信片墙 · 世界各地风景
landmark_G:2.phrase_en: Look at the postcards — sunny beaches, snowy mountains, and green forests!
landmark_G:2.phrase_zh: 欣赏左侧明信片湾上的风景——有阳光海滩、雪山和绿森林！

landmark_G:3.object_zh: 大地球仪 · 海洋与陆地
landmark_G:3.phrase_en: Spin the big blue globe and find oceans, islands, and countries!
landmark_G:3.phrase_zh: 轻轻转动中央蔚蓝的大地球仪，找找广阔的海洋与不同国家吧！

landmark_G:4.object_zh: 打包木桌 · 旅行小箱
landmark_G:4.phrase_en: Pack your map, notebook, and hat neatly into the travel bag.
landmark_G:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧打包桌上把地图、笔记本和帽子整齐收进行李包里。

landmark_G:5.object_zh: 航线地图墙 · 指南针
landmark_G:5.phrase_en: Trace our next island adventure route on the big wall map!
landmark_G:5.phrase_zh: 顺着出口路线墙上的地图与指南针，规划我们的下一站旅行吧！

landmark_H:1.object_zh: 帽型图牌 · 试戴指南
landmark_H:1.phrase_en: Look at the hat board — do you need a sun hat or a warm wool cap?
landmark_H:1.phrase_zh: 看看店门口的试戴图牌——今天想选遮阳草帽还是暖绒帽呢？

landmark_H:2.object_zh: 布料木架 · 彩色布卷
landmark_H:2.phrase_en: Touch the soft red felt and blue cotton rolls on the fabric shelf.
landmark_H:2.phrase_zh: 摸一摸左侧布料架上的红毛毡和蓝棉布，颜色多鲜艳呀。

landmark_H:3.object_zh: 全身试戴镜 · 比大小
landmark_H:3.phrase_en: Try on the wide hat in front of the mirror — does it fit just right?
landmark_H:3.phrase_zh: 站在中央试戴镜前戴上宽檐帽照一照——大小刚刚好吗？

landmark_H:4.object_zh: 修整工作桌 · 帽带花饰
landmark_H:4.phrase_en: Decorate the brim of your hat with a silk ribbon and a little flower.
landmark_H:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧修整桌上为帽子系上一条丝带，再别一朵精致小花。

landmark_H:5.object_zh: 成品帽架 · 各式礼帽
landmark_H:5.phrase_en: Hang your finished hat proudly on the wooden display stand!
landmark_H:5.phrase_zh: 把亲手装饰好的漂亮帽子挂上出口帽架展示吧！

landmark_I:1.object_zh: 甜筒点单牌 · 口味图
landmark_I:1.phrase_en: Read the picture menu — strawberry, milk, or sweet mango ice cream?
landmark_I:1.phrase_zh: 看看入口点单图牌——今天想尝草莓、牛奶还是甜芒果冰淇淋？

landmark_I:2.object_zh: 冰霜口味柜 · 冰淇淋球
landmark_I:2.phrase_en: Look inside the cold glass freezer full of colourful ice cream tubs!
landmark_I:2.phrase_zh: 透过左侧冰凉的玻璃口味柜，看看五颜六色的冰淇淋球！

landmark_I:3.object_zh: 中央甜筒台 · 脆皮蛋筒
landmark_I:3.phrase_en: Put two cool scoops of ice cream onto a crispy waffle cone!
landmark_I:3.phrase_zh: 在中央冰淇淋台往脆皮蛋筒上稳稳叠起两颗清凉冰淇淋球！

landmark_I:4.object_zh: 缤纷配料槽 · 果干糖珠
landmark_I:4.phrase_en: Sprinkle sweet berries and crunchy nuts on top of your ice cream.
landmark_I:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧配料槽给冰淇淋撒上酸甜莓果粒和香脆坚果碎吧。

landmark_I:5.object_zh: 取餐小吧台 · 礼貌道谢
landmark_I:5.phrase_en: Take your cold ice cream cone at the counter and say: Thank you!
landmark_I:5.phrase_zh: 在出口取餐台双手接过冰凉甜筒，礼貌地说一声谢谢吧！

landmark_J:1.object_zh: 寄存木盘 · 新拾贝壳
landmark_J:1.phrase_en: Place your newly found seashell gently onto the wooden tray.
landmark_J:1.phrase_zh: 把刚从海边捡来的漂亮小贝壳轻轻放在入口寄存盘上。

landmark_J:2.object_zh: 材质分类格 · 透明玻璃罐
landmark_J:2.phrase_en: Sort shells, smooth stones, and buttons into clear glass jars.
landmark_J:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧分类格把贝壳、鹅卵石和彩扣分别装进透明玻璃罐里。

landmark_J:3.object_zh: 中央分拣转台 · 放大镜
landmark_J:3.phrase_en: Turn the wooden tray to compare big jars and tiny jars!
landmark_J:3.phrase_zh: 轻轻转动中央分拣转台，比一比哪只玻璃罐大、哪只小！

landmark_J:4.object_zh: 清洁贴签台 · 姓名标签
landmark_J:4.phrase_en: Wipe the glass jar clean and stick a neat name tag on the lid.
landmark_J:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧贴签台把玻璃罐擦得透亮，再贴上整洁的收藏标签。

landmark_J:5.object_zh: 晶亮展柜 · 珍藏玻璃罐
landmark_J:5.phrase_en: Look at the sparkling glass jars shining inside the display case!
landmark_J:5.phrase_zh: 欣赏出口收藏展柜里一排排闪闪发亮的玻璃宝藏罐吧！

landmark_K:1.object_zh: 风筝图纸架 · 燕子造型
landmark_K:1.phrase_en: Choose a kite drawing on the board — a bird kite or a star kite!
landmark_K:1.phrase_zh: 看看入口制作图，挑一款喜欢的燕子风筝或星星风筝造型吧！

landmark_K:2.object_zh: 材料木格 · 彩纸与线轴
landmark_K:2.phrase_en: Take light colourful paper and a roll of strong kite string.
landmark_K:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧材料格取出轻盈的彩纸和一卷结实的风筝细线。

landmark_K:3.object_zh: 风筝骨架桌 · 竹条拼搭
landmark_K:3.phrase_en: Cross two light bamboo sticks and paste bright paper on the kite.
landmark_K:3.phrase_zh: 在中央骨架桌上交叉绑好轻竹条，糊上鲜艳的风筝面。

landmark_K:4.object_zh: 风带测试口 · 测风飘带
landmark_K:4.phrase_en: Watch the colourful ribbons flutter — the breeze is strong enough!
landmark_K:4.phrase_zh: 观察右侧测试口飞舞的彩带——微风正好，足够托起风筝啦！

landmark_K:5.object_zh: 风筝长廊 · 彩绘成品
landmark_K:5.phrase_en: Hang your finished kite in the gallery before flying it high!
landmark_K:5.phrase_zh: 把做好的彩绘风筝挂上出口长廊展示，再去草地迎风放飞吧！

landmark_L:1.object_zh: 时刻木牌 · 傍晚相约
landmark_L:1.phrase_en: Check the lantern station clock — friends will visit this evening!
landmark_L:1.phrase_zh: 看看入口拜访时刻牌——好朋友们约好今天傍晚来相聚！

landmark_L:2.object_zh: 修整木架 · 灯纸与竹提手
landmark_L:2.phrase_en: Mend the warm paper shade and fix the bamboo lantern handle.
landmark_L:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧修整架粘好柔和的灯纸，装稳竹子小提手。

landmark_L:3.object_zh: 暖光会客圆桌 · 桌心灯笼
landmark_L:3.phrase_en: Sit around the warm lantern table and greet our evening guests!
landmark_L:3.phrase_zh: 围坐在点着暖灯笼的中央圆桌旁，热情招呼来访的朋友！

landmark_L:4.object_zh: 邀请卡木桌 · 手绘灯笼卡
landmark_L:4.phrase_en: Write a warm invitation card to invite neighbours to our lantern night.
landmark_L:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧邀请卡桌上画一盏小灯笼，写下温暖的聚会邀请卡。

landmark_L:5.object_zh: 亮灯长廊 · 一串暖灯笼
landmark_L:5.phrase_en: Walk down the glowing corridor lit by rows of golden lanterns!
landmark_L:5.phrase_zh: 沿着挂满金色暖灯笼的出口长廊散步，灯光照亮回家的路！

landmark_M:1.object_zh: 拖鞋藤篮 · 迎客门垫
landmark_M:1.phrase_en: Change into cosy slippers by the basket when visiting a friend's room.
landmark_M:1.phrase_zh: 到蘑菇邻居屋做客时，在门口拖鞋篮旁换上柔软舒适的拖鞋吧。

landmark_M:2.object_zh: 邻居相册墙 · 好朋友笑脸
landmark_M:2.phrase_en: Meet all our friendly forest neighbours on the photo wall!
landmark_M:2.phrase_zh: 看看左侧相册墙上的笑脸，认识住在树林里的每一位好邻居！

landmark_M:3.object_zh: 蘑菇圆茶桌 · 森林茶点
landmark_M:3.phrase_en: Please sit down at the round mushroom table and share sweet snacks!
landmark_M:3.phrase_zh: 请在中央圆圆的蘑菇茶桌旁坐下，一起品尝香甜小点心吧！

landmark_M:4.object_zh: 靠窗软沙发 · 林间窗景
landmark_M:4.phrase_en: Relax on the soft sofa by the window and chat with your friend.
landmark_M:4.phrase_zh: 坐在右侧松软的沙发窗台边，看着林间美景和好朋友聊聊天。

landmark_M:5.object_zh: 邻里分享柜 · 互借好物
landmark_M:5.phrase_en: Borrow a storybook or puzzle from the neighbour sharing shelf!
landmark_M:5.phrase_zh: 从出口分享柜挑一本图画书或拼图借回家，读完记得送回来哦！

landmark_N:1.object_zh: 护鸟枝牌 · 安静观察守则
landmark_N:1.phrase_en: Shh! Keep your voice soft so we do not scare the little birds.
landmark_N:1.phrase_zh: 嘘！看看入口枝条守则牌，放轻脚步，别惊扰枝头的小鸟哦。

landmark_N:2.object_zh: 观鸟望远镜 · 树冠枝头
landmark_N:2.phrase_en: Look through the binoculars — two blue birds are singing in the tree!
landmark_N:2.phrase_zh: 透过左侧望远镜往树冠看——两只蓝羽毛小鸟正在枝头唱歌呢！

landmark_N:3.object_zh: 观察记录台 · 草编鸟巢
landmark_N:3.phrase_en: Count how many cosy grass nests rest safely among the branches.
landmark_N:3.phrase_zh: 在中央记录台写下观察笔记，数数树枝间藏着几个温暖的小鸟巢。

landmark_N:4.object_zh: 护鸟食水架 · 清水与浆果
landmark_N:4.phrase_en: Leave clean water and berries on the tray for flying birds.
landmark_N:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧食水托架添上干净清水与小浆果，招待飞累的小鸟。

landmark_N:5.object_zh: 观察日记栏 · 飞鸟速写
landmark_N:5.phrase_en: Pin your bird and nest drawing onto the nature diary board!
landmark_N:5.phrase_zh: 把你画的小鸟与鸟巢观察图贴到出口日记栏上展示吧！

landmark_O:1.object_zh: 借阅木台 · 猫头鹰图书卡
landmark_O:1.phrase_en: Show your owl reading card at the front desk to borrow a book.
landmark_O:1.phrase_zh: 在图书馆入口借阅台出示你的小读者卡，借阅喜欢的绘本吧。

landmark_O:2.object_zh: 主题高书架 · 科学童话书
landmark_O:2.phrase_en: Search the tall wooden shelves for animal stories and science books!
landmark_O:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧高高的主题书架间找一找有趣的动物故事和科学书！

landmark_O:3.object_zh: 提问圆木桌 · 故事讨论
landmark_O:3.phrase_en: Gather at the round table and ask: Who is the hero in this story?
landmark_O:3.phrase_zh: 围坐在中央提问圆桌旁轻声交流：这个故事里的主角是谁呢？

landmark_O:4.object_zh: 圆眼窗阅读湾 · 安静读书角
landmark_O:4.phrase_en: Curl up by the round owl window and read quietly in the soft light.
landmark_O:4.phrase_zh: 坐在猫头鹰大圆眼窗旁的阅读湾里，伴着柔和阳光安静读书。

landmark_O:5.object_zh: 木质还书车 · 图书归位
landmark_O:5.phrase_en: Place your finished storybook neatly back onto the return cart.
landmark_O:5.phrase_zh: 读完故事后，记得把绘本整整齐齐放回出口还书车上哦。

landmark_P:1.object_zh: 农时木牌 · 金秋种植季
landmark_P:1.phrase_en: Read the farm board — autumn is harvest season for golden pumpkins!
landmark_P:1.phrase_zh: 看看农场门口的季节牌——金秋正是大南瓜丰收的好时节！

landmark_P:2.object_zh: 农具木台 · 南瓜籽与小铲
landmark_P:2.phrase_en: Take plump pumpkin seeds and a hand trowel from the tool bench.
landmark_P:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧工具台挑几颗饱满的南瓜籽，拿起趁手的小园艺铲。

landmark_P:3.object_zh: 瓜藤田垄 · 圆滚滚大南瓜
landmark_P:3.phrase_en: Look under the wide green leaves — a round orange pumpkin is growing!
landmark_P:3.phrase_zh: 拨开中央田垄宽大的绿叶看一看——圆滚滚的橙色大南瓜正长高呢！

landmark_P:4.object_zh: 丰收木秤台 · 比比谁更大
landmark_P:4.phrase_en: Weigh two pumpkins on the scale — this orange pumpkin is heavier!
landmark_P:4.phrase_zh: 把两个南瓜抱上右侧秤台比一比——左边这个橙南瓜更重更大！

landmark_P:5.object_zh: 农产木篮架 · 丰收分享篮
landmark_P:5.phrase_en: Load ripe pumpkins into the wooden basket to share with the canteen!
landmark_P:5.phrase_zh: 把熟透的金黄南瓜装进出口木篮架，送去食堂煮香甜南瓜汤吧！

landmark_Q:1.object_zh: 故事封面夹 · 挑选主题
landmark_Q:1.phrase_en: Open the patchwork folder and pick today's fairy-tale theme!
landmark_Q:1.phrase_zh: 翻开入口拼布封面夹，挑选今天想编织的童话故事主题吧！

landmark_Q:2.object_zh: 图卡木抽屉 · 角色与场景卡
landmark_Q:2.phrase_en: Pull open the wooden drawer to pick character and scene picture cards.
landmark_Q:2.phrase_zh: 拉开左侧图片卡抽屉，挑出有趣的人物卡与小岛场景卡。

landmark_Q:3.object_zh: 拼布故事桌 · 先后顺序拼图
landmark_Q:3.phrase_en: Lay the quilt squares in order: first, then, and finally!
landmark_Q:3.phrase_zh: 在中央拼布故事桌上按先后顺序铺好彩布块，串起完整故事！

landmark_Q:4.object_zh: 软布坐垫 · 给朋友讲故事
landmark_Q:4.phrase_en: Sit on the colourful quilt cushion and tell your story aloud!
landmark_Q:4.phrase_zh: 盘腿坐在右侧柔软的拼布坐垫上，把你排好的故事讲给伙伴听！

landmark_Q:5.object_zh: 故事被展墙 · 百衲故事挂毯
landmark_Q:5.phrase_en: Admire the giant colourful story quilt hanging on the warm wall!
landmark_Q:5.phrase_zh: 抬头看看出口展墙上悬挂的大幅五彩拼布被，每一格都是一段回忆！

landmark_R:1.object_zh: 指令卡槽 · 前进左转卡
landmark_R:1.phrase_en: Insert action cards into the slot: go straight, turn left, then stop!
landmark_R:1.phrase_zh: 把动作指令卡插进门口卡槽：直走、左转，然后稳稳停下！

landmark_R:2.object_zh: 零件收纳格 · 齿轮与小轮子
landmark_R:2.phrase_en: Find shiny gears, springs, and wheels in the robot parts tray.
landmark_R:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧零件格里找出闪亮的小齿轮、发条弹簧和滚轮。

landmark_R:3.object_zh: 中央测试台 · 发条小机器人
landmark_R:3.phrase_en: Press start and watch the little robot march along the test track!
landmark_R:3.phrase_zh: 按下启动键，看发条小机器人沿着中央测试台轨道咔哒前进！

landmark_R:4.object_zh: 维修工作桌 · 拧紧机械臂
landmark_R:4.phrase_en: Use the small wrench to tighten the robot's waving metal arm.
landmark_R:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧维修桌上拿起小扳手，帮小机器人拧紧会挥手的机械臂。

landmark_R:5.object_zh: 完成状态屏 · 绿灯亮起
landmark_R:5.phrase_en: Green light on the screen! Our helper robot finished every task!
landmark_R:5.phrase_zh: 出口状态屏亮起绿灯啦！能干的小机器人顺利完成了全部指令！

landmark_S:1.object_zh: 昼夜转盘 · 白昼与星空
landmark_S:1.phrase_en: Turn the wooden wheel to see how bright day changes into starry night.
landmark_S:1.phrase_zh: 轻轻转动门口的昼夜圆盘，观察晴朗白昼怎样变成璀璨星夜。

landmark_S:2.object_zh: 发光星图台 · 连星成图
landmark_S:2.phrase_en: Connect the glowing dots on the star map to find the Big Bear!
landmark_S:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧发光星图台上把闪亮的星星连成线，找找大熊星座吧！

landmark_S:3.object_zh: 中央天球仪 · 旋转星轨
landmark_S:3.phrase_en: Turn the brass sky globe to see stars shining high above our island.
landmark_S:3.phrase_zh: 拨动中央精巧的天球仪，看看小岛夜空上方旋转的闪亮星群。

landmark_S:4.object_zh: 观星望远镜 · 寻找月亮与亮星
landmark_S:4.phrase_en: Look through the dome telescope — the silver moon and stars are so clear!
landmark_S:4.phrase_zh: 凑近右侧大望远镜仰望夜空——银色月亮和金星星清晰极啦！

landmark_S:5.object_zh: 星空展示角 · 观星小发现
landmark_S:5.phrase_en: Pin your starlight observation card onto the observatory board!
landmark_S:5.phrase_zh: 把今晚观测到的星星与月亮记录卡贴在出口发现展示角吧！

landmark_T:1.object_zh: 发车时刻牌 · 列车时间表
landmark_T:1.phrase_en: Check the station timetable — the red train leaves at nine o'clock!
landmark_T:1.phrase_zh: 抬头看看车站入口时刻牌——红色小火车九点整准时发车！

landmark_T:2.object_zh: 木质售票窗 · 小火车票
landmark_T:2.phrase_en: Buy a train ticket to Harbour Bay at the sunny ticket window, please.
landmark_T:2.phrase_zh: 在左侧售票窗礼貌说明目的地，领一张前往海湾站的小车票吧。

landmark_T:3.object_zh: 中央候车站台 · 安全候车线
landmark_T:3.phrase_en: Stand behind the yellow line on the platform while waiting for the train.
landmark_T:3.phrase_zh: 站在中央候车站台的安全黄线内，听小火车呜呜拉响汽笛进站！

landmark_T:4.object_zh: 站台行李架 · 整齐提包
landmark_T:4.phrase_en: Put your heavy bag and suitcase safely onto the station luggage rack.
landmark_T:4.phrase_zh: 把随身旅行包和小皮箱稳稳放到右侧站台行李架上。

landmark_T:5.object_zh: 到站显示牌 · 下一站提示
landmark_T:5.phrase_en: Look at the arrival screen — next stop is Central Island Square!
landmark_T:5.phrase_zh: 看看出口到站显示屏——列车的下一站是字母岛中央广场！

landmark_U:1.object_zh: 晴雨风向盘 · 今日天气
landmark_U:1.phrase_en: Spin the weather wheel to today's icon: is it sunny, windy, or rainy?
landmark_U:1.phrase_zh: 拨动门口的天气轮盘对准今天的天空：是晴天、微风还是下雨呢？

landmark_U:2.object_zh: 雨具衣帽架 · 雨伞与雨衣
landmark_U:2.phrase_en: It is raining outside — grab a bright umbrella and raincoat from the stand!
landmark_U:2.phrase_zh: 窗外下起小雨啦——快从左侧衣帽架拿起花雨伞和小雨衣吧！

landmark_U:3.object_zh: 中央雨量柱 · 测雨刻度管
landmark_U:3.phrase_en: Read the clear glass tube to measure how much rain fell today.
landmark_U:3.phrase_zh: 观察中央透明雨量柱上的刻度，看看今天一共下了多少雨水。

landmark_U:4.object_zh: 天气活动桌 · 晴天野餐雨天读书
landmark_U:4.phrase_en: Plan our day by the weather: fly kites on sunny days, read books on rainy days!
landmark_U:4.phrase_zh: 在右侧计划桌按天气安排活动：晴天去放风筝，雨天在屋里读绘本！

landmark_U:5.object_zh: 小小气象窗 · 播报明日天气
landmark_U:5.phrase_en: Stand at the forecast window and tell neighbours: Tomorrow will be warm and sunny!
landmark_U:5.phrase_zh: 站在出口播报窗前当小小气象员：明天会是温暖晴朗的好天气哦！

landmark_V:1.object_zh: 登山路线牌 · 环山观察步道
landmark_V:1.phrase_en: Follow the wooden trail sign to walk safely around the quiet volcano hill.
landmark_V:1.phrase_zh: 对照入口路线牌，沿着平缓安全的环山步道开启岩石观察之旅。

landmark_V:2.object_zh: 岩石样本台 · 粗糙火山石
landmark_V:2.phrase_en: Touch the volcano rock on the table — it feels rough, porous, and light!
landmark_V:2.phrase_zh: 摸一摸左侧样本台上的休眠火山石——表面粗糙又有细小气孔！

landmark_V:3.object_zh: 火山地形沙盘 · 山顶与山脚
landmark_V:3.phrase_en: Look at the 3D sand model to compare the round crater peak and gentle foot.
landmark_V:3.phrase_zh: 围着中央火山地形沙盘看一看，比较圆圆的山顶与平缓的山脚。

landmark_V:4.object_zh: 岩层观察窗 · 彩色地质条纹
landmark_V:4.phrase_en: Count the brown, red, and grey rock layers through the viewing window!
landmark_V:4.phrase_zh: 透过右侧岩层观察窗数一数：棕色、红褐色与灰色的岩石纹理真奇妙！

landmark_V:5.object_zh: 探险记录架 · 地质考察本
landmark_V:5.phrase_en: Stamp your explorer notebook on the shelf after finishing the hill walk!
landmark_V:5.phrase_zh: 完成火山观察站巡礼后，在出口记录架上给探险手册盖个纪念章吧！

landmark_W:1.object_zh: 海洋导览图 · 蔚蓝航程
landmark_W:1.phrase_en: Trace the blue ocean map to see where gentle whales swim and sing!
landmark_W:1.phrase_zh: 顺着入口海洋旅程图看一看，温柔的大蓝鲸在哪些海域巡游歌唱！

landmark_W:2.object_zh: 海岸样本池 · 贝壳与海星
landmark_W:2.phrase_en: Look into the shallow tide pool at spiral shells and little starfish.
landmark_W:2.phrase_zh: 低头看看左侧浅水样本池里的螺旋花贝壳和彩色小海星。

landmark_W:3.object_zh: 鲸鱼比例地毯 · 比比有多长
landmark_W:3.phrase_en: Walk from head to tail on the blue whale rug — whales are huge!
landmark_W:3.phrase_zh: 从中央蓝鲸比例地毯的鼻尖走到尾鳍——原来蓝鲸这么巨大呀！

landmark_W:4.object_zh: 海底观察巨窗 · 鲸鱼跃游
landmark_W:4.phrase_en: Watch through the giant blue window as a whale waves its wide tail!
landmark_W:4.phrase_zh: 站在右侧蔚蓝海底巨窗前，看大蓝鲸摇动宽大尾鳍悠然游过！

landmark_W:5.object_zh: 尾鳍分享湾 · 守护蔚蓝大海
landmark_W:5.phrase_en: Share your favourite sea animal at the bay and promise to keep oceans clean!
landmark_W:5.phrase_zh: 在出口尾鳍分享湾聊聊你最爱的海洋动物，一起守护洁净大海！

landmark_X:1.object_zh: 排练日程牌 · 海风音乐会
landmark_X:1.phrase_en: Check the seaside stage board for our afternoon xylophone rehearsal!
landmark_X:1.phrase_zh: 看看海边舞台门口的日程牌，确认下午木琴合奏的排练时间！

landmark_X:2.object_zh: 木琴槌架 · 圆头小琴槌
landmark_X:2.phrase_en: Take two round-headed mallets from the stand and pass a pair to your friend.
landmark_X:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧琴槌架取两支圆头小琴槌，再递给身旁合奏伙伴一对吧。

landmark_X:3.object_zh: 中央彩木琴 · 叮咚音条
landmark_X:3.phrase_en: Tap the long and short xylophone bars — ding-dong, listen to the clear notes!
landmark_X:3.phrase_zh: 轻轻敲击中央彩木琴长短不同的音条——叮咚叮咚，音色多清脆呀！

landmark_X:4.object_zh: 合奏脚印位 · 默契轮流敲
landmark_X:4.phrase_en: Stand on the painted footprints and play a cheerful duet together!
landmark_X:4.phrase_zh: 踩在右侧彩色合奏脚印位上，和小伙伴一唱一和敲出欢快旋律！

landmark_X:5.object_zh: 海边演出照架 · 谢幕合影
landmark_X:5.phrase_en: Smile by the seaside photo stand to celebrate our wonderful concert!
landmark_X:5.phrase_zh: 在出口演出照片架前开心地比个耶，纪念这场精彩的海风音乐会！

landmark_Y:1.object_zh: 手作样卡板 · 绒线小物图
landmark_Y:1.phrase_en: Pick a craft pattern card — let's weave a warm scarf or a cup coaster!
landmark_Y:1.phrase_zh: 在入口手作样卡板上挑一张图样——今天来织小围巾还是杯垫呢？

landmark_Y:2.object_zh: 毛线轴木架 · 五彩软绒线
landmark_Y:2.phrase_en: Touch the yarn spools on the rack — pink, yellow, and sky-blue wool feel so soft!
landmark_Y:2.phrase_zh: 摸摸左侧木架上的毛线团——粉的、黄的、天蓝的绒线软绵绵真舒服！

landmark_Y:3.object_zh: 中央绕线器 · 绕成圆线团
landmark_Y:3.phrase_en: Turn the wooden handle gently to wind loose yarn into a neat round ball.
landmark_Y:3.phrase_zh: 轻轻摇动中央木绕线器的手柄，把松散毛线绕成圆滚滚的线团。

landmark_Y:4.object_zh: 编织工作桌 · 巧手织毛线
landmark_Y:4.phrase_en: Weave the colourful yarn threads across the loom step by step.
landmark_Y:4.phrase_zh: 坐在右侧织作桌前，按图样把彩色绒线一针一线编织成温暖布片。

landmark_Y:5.object_zh: 绒线礼盒台 · 暖心手作礼
landmark_Y:5.phrase_en: Pack your soft handmade scarf into a gift box: This warm gift is for you!
landmark_Y:5.phrase_zh: 在出口礼盒台把织好的软围巾装进礼盒：这份暖心礼物送给你！

landmark_Z:1.object_zh: 斑马收件箱 · 待寄信件
landmark_Z:1.phrase_en: Check the striped postbox at the door for letters waiting to travel!
landmark_Z:1.phrase_zh: 看看邮局门口黑白条纹收件箱里有哪些等待出发的信件与明信片！

landmark_Z:2.object_zh: 地址分拣格 · 按街区归类
landmark_Z:2.phrase_en: Read the island address on each envelope and sort it into the right box.
landmark_Z:2.phrase_zh: 仔细看清信封上的小岛地址，在左侧分拣格按街区准确归类。

landmark_Z:3.object_zh: 中央写信桌 · 贴邮票写祝福
landmark_Z:3.phrase_en: Write a kind note on a postcard and stick a cute zebra stamp in the corner!
landmark_Z:3.phrase_zh: 在中央写信桌写下温暖祝福，再在明信片右上角贴一张小斑马邮票！

landmark_Z:4.object_zh: 路线邮袋架 · 投递帆布袋
landmark_Z:4.phrase_en: Put the sorted letters into the harbour, school, and village mailbags.
landmark_Z:4.phrase_zh: 把分拣好的信件分别装进右侧前往港口、校园和广场的帆布邮袋里。

landmark_Z:5.object_zh: 旅程邮戳墙 · 纪念邮戳印记
landmark_Z:5.phrase_en: Press a round postmark stamp to see all the places our letters visited!
landmark_Z:5.phrase_zh: 在出口邮戳墙盖一枚圆圆的纪念戳，看看信件走遍了小岛多少角落！

music_room:1.object_zh: 乐谱木柜 · 五线谱歌本
music_room:1.phrase_en: Open the songbook on the cabinet to pick a happy melody to sing!
music_room:1.phrase_zh: 翻开入口乐谱柜上的歌本，挑一首轻快好听的英文歌来学唱吧！
music_room:1.activity_zh: 翻看示例乐谱并认识乐器图标

music_room:2.object_zh: 三角钢琴 · 黑白琴键
music_room:2.phrase_en: Press the black and white piano keys gently to hear sweet notes!
music_room:2.phrase_zh: 走近三角钢琴观察整齐的黑白琴键，轻轻按下听听悦耳的琴声！

music_room:3.object_zh: 节奏圆鼓 · 欢快节拍
music_room:3.phrase_en: Tap a steady one-two-three beat on the classroom rhythm drum!
music_room:3.phrase_zh: 拍打音乐室里的节奏圆鼓，打出“咚哒、咚哒”的欢快节拍！

music_room:4.object_zh: 弦乐器架 · 小提琴与琴弓
music_room:4.phrase_en: Look at the wooden violin and bow resting neatly on the string rack.
music_room:4.phrase_zh: 仔细观察弦乐器架上优雅的木制小提琴与细长琴弓。

music_room:5.object_zh: 合唱小舞台 · 登台演唱
music_room:5.phrase_en: Step onto the little music stage and sing a cheerful song with friends!
music_room:5.phrase_zh: 站上音乐室的小舞台，和伙伴们自信快乐地合唱一首歌吧！
music_room:5.activity_zh: 在舞台前回顾见到的乐器

playground:1.object_zh: 活动约定牌 · 轮流友好玩耍
playground:1.phrase_en: Read the playground board: let's play safely and take turns with friends!
playground:1.phrase_zh: 看看操场入口约定牌：和伙伴安全运动、互相礼让、轮流玩耍！
playground:1.activity_zh: 选择活动并看轮流图标

playground:2.object_zh: 运动器材架 · 彩球与长跳绳
playground:2.phrase_en: Pick a bouncy ball or a skipping rope from the playground rack!
playground:2.phrase_zh: 从左侧器材架挑一颗弹性十足的彩球或一根彩色跳绳吧！

playground:3.object_zh: 中央合作游戏圈 · 手拉手做游戏
playground:3.phrase_en: Join the sunny grass circle and call out: Come and play with us!
playground:3.phrase_zh: 跑进青草操场中央的合作游戏圈，热情招呼伙伴一起来做游戏！

playground:4.object_zh: 彩虹跳格线 · 边跳边数数
playground:4.phrase_en: Hop along the painted squares on the ground: one, two, three, four, five!
playground:4.phrase_zh: 顺着右侧地面彩绘跳格线轻快单脚跳：一、二、三、四、五！
playground:4.activity_zh: 按已教过的数字或动作提示移动

playground:5.object_zh: 课间照片栏 · 活力笑脸墙
playground:5.phrase_en: Look at the playground photo board full of running and laughing friends!
playground:5.phrase_zh: 看看出口活动照片栏里大家在阳光下奔跑欢笑的精彩瞬间吧！

school:1.object_zh: 校门导览牌 · 学园地图
school:1.phrase_en: Look at the campus map by the gate to find all seven school rooms!
school:1.phrase_zh: 在校门导览牌前看清校园地图，认识教室、食堂与操场七处场所！
school:1.activity_zh: 从校门导览认识校园与七处可进入场所

school:2.object_zh: 教学楼门廊 · 四间教室门牌
school:2.phrase_en: Read the door signs ahead: Classroom, Music Room, Art Room, and Science Room!
school:2.phrase_zh: 站在教学楼前认一认门牌：阳光教室、音乐室、美术室和科学室！
school:2.activity_zh: 在教学楼前辨认普通、音乐、美术和科学教室入口

school:3.object_zh: 中心小花园 · 校园花草
school:3.phrase_en: Walk along the sunny garden path and smell the blooming campus flowers.
school:3.phrase_zh: 沿着中心花园的石子路散步，观察校园里盛开的花朵与青草。
school:3.activity_zh: 观察校园花草并熟悉庭院环路

school:4.object_zh: 操场入口器材架 · 球与跳绳
school:4.phrase_en: Check the sports stand by the playground gate for balls and jump ropes!
school:4.phrase_zh: 在通往操场的运动器材旁认一认篮球、足球和彩色跳绳！
school:4.activity_zh: 认识操场入口与运动器材

school:5.object_zh: 餐厅菜单牌 · 今日营养午餐
school:5.phrase_en: Read today's lunch menu outside the canteen — warm soup, bread, and fruit!
school:5.phrase_zh: 看看食堂门口的今日菜单牌——有热汤、松软面包和新鲜水果！
school:5.activity_zh: 看餐厅菜单并辨认食堂入口

science_room:1.object_zh: 安全准备区 · 护目镜与放大镜
science_room:1.phrase_en: Put on safety goggles and pick up a magnifying glass before our experiment!
science_room:1.phrase_zh: 做实验前先到安全准备区戴好护目镜，拿起清晰的小放大镜！
science_room:1.activity_zh: 看准备物品和观察约定图示

science_room:2.object_zh: 显微镜实验台 · 微观观察镜
science_room:2.phrase_en: Look through the microscope lens to see tiny veins on a green leaf!
science_room:2.phrase_zh: 凑近显微镜台的目镜看一看——绿叶片上细小的叶脉清晰可见！
science_room:2.activity_zh: 认识显微镜及示例观察图

science_room:3.object_zh: 植物观察台 · 发芽小豆苗
science_room:3.phrase_en: Measure how tall the green bean plant grew in the sunlight this week!
science_room:3.phrase_zh: 在植物观察台量一量向阳生长的小豆苗这周又长出了几片新叶！
science_room:3.activity_zh: 观察植物的叶片与生长记录示例

science_room:4.object_zh: 磁铁实验台 · 红蓝吸铁石
science_room:4.phrase_en: Bring the U-shaped magnet close — click! It pulls the metal clips right up!
science_room:4.phrase_zh: 把磁铁实验台上的红蓝磁铁靠近回形针——啪！金属回形针被吸起来啦！
science_room:4.activity_zh: 比较磁铁与物件的图示关系

science_room:5.object_zh: 科学模型架 · 恐龙与太阳系模型
science_room:5.phrase_en: Explore the dinosaur skeleton and planet models on the science shelf!
science_room:5.phrase_zh: 看看模型展示架上酷酷的恐龙骨架模型与旋转的行星仪吧！
